notes.title: Steam Achievements Implementation
notes.content:
[h1]Achievements[/h1]

As a single indie developer, I am more than pleased to announce that [b]Raising Torolith[/b] finally features Steam Achievements! A great milestone as the game is getting closer to release.

If raising an entire kingdom is not enough for you - now you'll have more tasks to dive into! This will be, of course, after the game gets released.

Special thanks to all early game supporters and have a great weekend!
